article.title_es: Next Step Community Church: comida en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Next Step Community Church: food help in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Next Step Community Church aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como lugar de comida en Brooklyn. Tiene cocina de comidas de lunes a miércoles y despensa de alimentos los sábados.
article.summary_en: Next Step Community Church appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food location in Brooklyn. It has a soup kitchen Monday to Wednesday and a food pantry on Saturdays.
how_they_help_es: Cocina de comidas: lunes, martes y miércoles de 9am a 10am.
Despensa de alimentos: sábados de 9am a 10:30am.
La despensa abre el 2.º, 3.º y 4.º sábado del mes.
Está en 360 Schermerhorn St, Brooklyn, NY 11217.
Qué alimentos entrega y si hay requisitos no están indicados; pregunte llamando al (718) 875-1858.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, 9am to 10am.
The pantry is open the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Saturday of the month.
Located at 360 Schermerhorn St, Brooklyn, NY 11217.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; ask by calling (718) 875-1858.
visit_tips_es: Llegue dentro del horario: 9am a 10am entre semana, o 9am a 10:30am los sábados de despensa.
Recuerde que la despensa solo abre el 2.º, 3.º y 4.º sábado del mes.
Si tiene dudas, llame antes al (718) 875-1858.
visit_tips_en: Go during the hours: 9am to 10am on weekdays, or 9am to 10:30am on pantry Saturdays.
Remember the pantry is only open the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Saturday of the month.
If you have questions, call ahead at (718) 875-1858.

Los sábados de 9am a 10:30am, solo el 2.º, 3.º y 4.º sábado del mes.

faq_en.q: What services does this place offer?
faq_en.a: According to the Food Help NYC map, it offers a soup kitchen on weekdays and a food pantry on Saturdays.
Saturdays from 9am to 10:30am, only on the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Saturday of the month.

faq_en.q: Do I need to bring anything or meet requirements?
faq_en.a: That is not listed in the available information. Call (718) 875-1858 to ask.
